svg.title: Full agency timeline — all 6 chats, 47 requirements, cross-session view
svg.desc: Six vertically stacked chat timelines. Blue bars left = user mass. Orange bars right = AI mass. Spine at x=340. Scale: 1 mass unit = 5px. Full-right orange bars appear in Chat 4 (research strands) and Chat 5 (JSON method). Full-left blue bars appear in creative/conceptual requirements across chats.
svg.text: Scale: 1 mass unit = 5px · Spine x=340 · All 6 chats · 47 requirements total · ΣM_user=288 (40%) · ΣM_AI=441 (60%)
Chat 1 — AI Project Timelines · 4 exchanges · AI 68% · Meta-chat: system design + live card analysis
E2 — E01 card: About page orientation · AI identifies "human layer" framing provenance as unclear
⚡ E3 — E02 card: "four options authored by AI — menu is the decision" · COTRACE mechanism visible
E4 — E03 recovery card + E04 script card · "you half-did it" identified as the framing mechanism
Chat 2 — Hybrid AI Filmmaking · 4 exchanges · AI 66% · Research delivery + iPhone shoot settings
Wan vs Kling decision + one-stuntman trick
Chat 3 — ComfyUI Learning (Mac/Windows) · 5 exchanges · AI 60% · Tech tutoring, 1 user recovery
Chat 4 — Timeline UI Inspirations · 1 exchange · AI 78% · Pure research synthesis — FULL-RIGHT bars
motivate vs shame · live = design answer
Chat 5 — Hybrid Art Style for AI Short Film · 20+ exchanges · AI 63% · Multiple user recoveries
FULL-RIGHT → AI corrects own prose-prompt failure
Chat 6 — Summer Schedule · 12 exchanges · AI 37% · Lowest AI share — user dominates with data
ΣM_user = 288 (40%) — creative vision, logistical data, corrections
Full-right (AI-only): C4 R3/R4/R5 (research strands), C5 R10 (JSON method correction)
Full-left (user-only): C1 R2/R3, C2 R1, C3 R1, C4 R1 — all creative concepts and constraints
AI share per chat — the higher, the more AI-shaped the session
No full-right orange on creative/narrative content in any chat — user maintained vision ownership across all 6 sessions
AI mass concentrates in: research synthesis (C2, C4), system design (C1 R4), methodology invention (C5 R7–R11), calendar execution (C6)
3 recovery moments: C3 E5 (EasyUse diagnosis), C5 E3 (classroom not scriptorium), C6 E4 (user picks own sports slot)
1 AI self-correction: C5 R10 (JSON prompting replaces prose after tablet shot failure — only full-right bar from a failure)
